item.title: Research Executive
item.description: JOB PROFILE: RESEARCH EXECUTIVE PURPOSE To be an effective team member to the business area and Division, in the design, set up and management of research projects and administrative tasks To learn and master the research basics and undertake project management tasks with supervision ENVIRONMENT Ipsos is among the world’s largest global research companies, with a presence across 220 cities and 90 markets. Our ambition is to make market research one of the primary means to understand contemporary society and economy. And to make Ipsos a strategic partner for those who wish to make better understand the world and play an active part in it, with lasting success. OUTPUTS/ACCOUNTABILITY Oversees the entire research process from start to finish together with the Senior Research Manager Key tasks includes: Timeline planning, desk research, screener design, questionnaire design, sampling, analysis plans, tab specs, data processing, report design / templates, data analysis and insights and presentations Ensures research basics and disciplines are implemented and upheld, including: logic checks, checklists, document standards, policies and procedures Responsible for overall quality control and all quality control documentation Ensures the process runs according to deadlines and budget together with the Project Manager Attempts initial value add / insights at each stage (development area) Develops basic Solutions knowledge Ensures integration of information from multiple sources where applicable and available Conducts desk research to add value to all reports / presentations and assist the client in understanding the South African market Assists with research design for entire project / process on small pitches Experience Knowledge of basic statistics Experience in questionnaire design, table specifications and project management Understanding of basic methodologies and techniques to provide input into research design Previous experience as a project manager or a research executive in a market research company will be an advantage Experience in innovation research or customised quantitative research will be an advantage Additional requirements: Excellent command of spoken and written English Exceptional presentation skills Excellent leadership and project management skills Must be able to build and maintain internal and external client relationships Analytical skills / Training skills / Delegation skills Excellent computing skills especially in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint Proactive with high energy levels Qualifications Degree in Business, Social Science, Statistics or related studies Note: This is a role that will report to a manager based in another country. While there are no time zone differences, you should be comfortable collaborating across borders. Strong communication skills, proactive updates, and adaptability are essential to ensure seamless teamwork in a international setup.

item.title: F2F Intern
item.description: In Ipsos Doxa siamo appassionati di persone, mercati, brand e società. La nostra ambizione è diventare partner di tutti i clienti che vogliono comprendere in profondità e dettaglio la loro audience, i mercati, i consumatori, e le marche in un mondo in rapida e continua evoluzione. Siamo un solido brand presente in 90 paesi e più di 20.000 professionisti, con un posizionamento unico di esperienze specifiche che allo stesso tempo si integrano in team dedicati. Crediamo che i nostri clienti ci chiedano molto di più di semplici dati. Hanno bisogno di un partner che lavori con loro per produrre informazioni puntuali e pertinenti e trasformarle in concrete strategie di business. Questo è il motivo per cui i nostri esperti mettono al servizio di aziende e istituzioni tutta la propria competenza e capacità di ascolto, non solo per fornire le rilevazioni più accurate ma anche per adattarle alle specifiche esigenze. Ci poniamo un unico obiettivo: quello di offrire a tutti i nostri clienti una comprensione totale di mercati, società e persone. Per fare ciò, usiamo un mix unico di competenze professionali, tecnologia e know-how tecnico applicando ad ogni cosa che facciamo i principi di sicurezza, semplicità, velocità e concretezza. In definitiva, crediamo che alla base del successo vi sia una semplice verità: YOU ACT BETTER WHEN YOU ARE SURE! La posizione Per la nostra sede di Milano siamo alla ricerca di una persona di talento da inserire in un percorso di stage nel ruolo di F2F INTERN Cosa farai? Supporterai il Fieldwork Manager e il Team Operations nelle diverse fasi operative del fieldwork per ricerche di mercato quantitative; Avrai contatto gli intervistatori e darai supporto nella gestione della rete di rilevatori e intervistatori sul territorio (individuazione nuovi intervistatori); Preparerai materiali, organizzazione e supporto nei briefing ai rilevatori e intervistatori su come condurre le interviste (ad es. assegnazione delle interviste e simulazioni, metodologie ad hoc da seguire, definizione dei contenuti dei questionari); Monitorerai l’avanzamento delle interviste su base quantitativa e/o secondo indicatori di performance; Supporterai il Fieldwork Manager nell’utilizzo di software gestionali specifici (inclusa la piattaforma Ipsos I-field) e interfacciandoti con varie figure interne (Data Processing, Market Researchers, ecc.); Acquisirai competenze di base nell’esecuzione degli aspetti operativi dei progetti di ricerca quantitativa; Chi cerchiamo? Persone curiose e appassionate, con: laurea in discipline economiche o umanistiche ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office (in particolare Excel) Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese Forte predisposizione alla precisione, alla cura dei dettagli e al lavoro di squadra Orientamento agli obiettivi definiti Cosa troverai un percorso altamente formativo all’interno di un Gruppo internazionale; un onboarding guidato e strutturato da Line Manager e HRBP per facilitare il tuo ingresso e inserimento in azienda; un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e molto attento alle persone e alle politiche in termini di ESG: Ambiente, Sostenibilità, People - D&I ampia flessibilità di orario e di lavoro da remoto per gestire al meglio il tuo tempo partecipazione ad attività interne di Benessere aziendale; formazione continua on the job, accesso alla piattaforma e-learning (Ipsos Training Center); un Team People & Culture HR a tua disposizione con cui potrai sempre confrontarti in caso di bisogno; l'opportunità di lavorare a stretto contatto con persone esperte del settore Altre informazioni Sede di Milano Rimborso spese di 700 euro + ticket restaurant Inizio stage: giugno 2026 6 mesi, 38 ore settimanali Taking Responsibility Ipsos riconosce la necessità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che valorizzi l'individualità e le diverse prospettive di ciascun lavoratore e lavoratrice. Da oltre 40 anni, la nostra missione è generare e analizzare dati sulla società, sui mercati, sui marchi e sui comportamenti per fornire ai nostri clienti gli approfondimenti che migliorano la loro comprensione del mondo. Questo non potrebbe essere realizzato senza le persone di Ipsos che compilano e analizzano questi dati: essi sono l'essenza di ciò che siamo e di ciò che facciamo. Ci impegniamo a offrire pari opportunità, a creare un ambiente che promuova l'inclusione. Ipsos incoraggia il proprio personale ad agire in modo rispettoso e responsabile, in linea con il codice e la nostra policy in materia di diversità e inclusione, diritti umani, uguaglianza e civiltà. Il processo di selezione Una volta ricevuta la tua candidatura, ci prenderemo il tempo necessario per valutarla attentamente. Nel caso in cui il tuo profilo sia in linea per questa o altre posizioni presso l'azienda, ci metteremo in contatto con te. Tuttavia, nel caso in cui non ci sia una corrispondenza al momento, non preoccuparti! ci assicureremo di tenere in considerazione il tuo cv per future opportunità in linea con il tuo profilo e nel totale rispetto della normativa privacy e GDPR. Tutte le candidature saranno prese in considerazione per la posizione senza riguardo all'età, alla razza, al colore della pelle, alla religione, al sesso, all'orientamento sessuale, all'identità di genere, all'origine nazionale, allo status di rifugiato o a qualsiasi altra categoria protetta e non saranno discriminati sulla base della disabilità. I nostri valori Siamo "Proud to be Ipsos" perché crediamo fortemente nella nostra cultura aziendale, incarnando i valori di Integrità – Collaborazione – Curiosità – Spirito Imprenditoriale – Attenzione al Cliente nei rapporti con i colleghi, con i clienti e con la società. Se ti riconosci nella nostra realtà e nei nostri valori, se hai l’ambizione di entrare a far parte di un’azienda dinamica e internazionale e desideri crescere insieme a noi, candidati ora e inizia il tuo viaggio nel mondo Ipsos! I dati personali raccolti ai fini del processo di selezione saranno trattati nel rispetto del Regolamento UE n. 679/2016.

item.title: Cloud Platform / Production Engineer
item.description: Senior Platform & Reliability Production Engineer – Audience Measurement Make Your Mark at Ipsos Ipsos CrossMedia is at a pivotal and exciting stage of growth, and we are looking for a motivated Production Engineer to join our innovative Data Science and Engineering teams. This is a fantastic opportunity to work on both high-profile, established projects for blue-chip clients and to contribute to brand-new, greenfield initiatives. What is in it for you? This is a fantastic opportunity for someone to enhance their career and develop key skills. You will get the opportunity to: Build and Manage Cloud Infrastructure: You will own the management of our production and development infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AWS. This includes our Kubernetes clusters, cloud storage, and identity and access management. Master Infrastructure as Code (IaC): You will design, write, and deploy code to manage our infrastructure using modern IaC tools like Terraform or Pulumi. This is a chance to build your skills in creating repeatable and robust systems. Automate Everything: You will be responsible for our CI/CD pipelines, using tools like GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps to automate the building, testing, and deployment of our applications and data workflows. Orchestrate Data Workflows: A core part of your role will be creating, maintaining, and monitoring our data ingestion and delivery pipelines using Argo Workflows. You'll ensure that data flows seamlessly and reliably to our clients and internal teams. Ensure System Reliability (SRE Principles): You will monitor the health and performance of our systems, ensuring efficient resource usage. When issues arise, you'll be on the front line, performing root cause analysis, deploying fixes, and providing Level 2 technical support. You'll also contribute to a blameless post-mortem culture to learn from incidents. Drive Continuous Improvement: You will be empowered to propose and implement structural improvements to our platform, from configuration management to system architecture. We want you to help us get better every day. Collaborate Across Teams: You will work closely with our talented Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Owners to build scalable, reliable, and secure solutions that meet their needs. Shared On-Call Responsibility: You will participate in a shared, rota-based, out-of-hours emergency on-call schedule. We strive to build resilient systems to keep this quiet, and we ensure our on-call engineers are well-supported. The Role: As a key member of our team, you will be at the heart of our data platform, ensuring its reliability, scalability, and efficiency. We are constantly evolving our workflows and are committed to investing in cutting-edge technology. If you are passionate about designing, building, and deploying resilient, distributed systems and want to make a tangible impact, you will thrive here. You won't just be maintaining systems; you'll have the autonomy to propose and implement new ideas and technologies that will shape the future of our data infrastructure. About you: The successful candidate will bring: Cloud Platform Experience: Professional experience with a major cloud provider (GCP, AWS, or Azure). We primarily use GCP and AWS, so experience there is a significant plus. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Knowledge of IaC principles and tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or Ansible. CI/CD: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows. Databases: Working knowledge of SQL and experience with relational databases or data warehouses. Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in a scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) and comfort with the Unix/Linux command line (we expect you to know your way around `grep`, `awk`, `sed`, etc.). ETL/Data Pipelines: Familiarity with data workflows and tools like Argo Workflows. Desirable Skills (Nice to Have) Containerization and Orchestration: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly desirable. Version Control: Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows (e.g., pull requests, code reviews). Experience of Windows IIS NoSQL Databases: Familiarity with NoSQL databases like MongoDB or DynamoDB. Agile and Project Tracking: Experience with tools like Jira or Azure DevOps. Networking Concepts: A good understanding of networking principles (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP). Security Best Practices: A good awareness of and interest in security and privacy in the cloud. Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you as an individual. Our standard benefits include 25 days annual leave, pension contribution, income protection and life assurance. In addition, there are a range of health & wellbeing, financial benefits and professional development opportunities. We realise you may have commitments outside of work and will consider flexible working applications - please highlight what you are looking for when you make your application. We have a hybrid approach to work and ask people to be in the office or with clients for 3 days per week. We are committed to equality, treating people fairly, promoting a positive and inclusive working environment and ensuring we have diversity of people and views. We recognise that this is important for our business success - a more diverse workforce will enable us to better reflect and understand the world we research and ultimately deliver better research and insight to our clients. We are proud to be a member of the Disability Confident scheme, certified as Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. We are dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Your application will be reviewed by someone from our Talent Team who will be in touch either way to let you know the outcome.

item.title: Project Executive (w/m/d) – trend·test
item.description: Als eines der weltweit führenden Marktforschungsunternehmen geht es bei Ipsos nicht nur um Zahlen. Wir entdecken tiefe Einblicke und bieten klare Handlungsempfehlungen, um unsere Kunden bei wichtigen Entscheidungen zu unterstützen. Unsere breite Palette von Expertisen umfasst alles von Car Clinics, die die Nutzerfreundlichkeit neuer Fahrzeugmodelle analysieren, bis hin zu umfangreichen Healthcare-Studien und der präzisen Analyse politischer Trends. Ob es um User Experience, die Effektivität von TV-Spots oder KI-gestützte Social Media-Analysen geht – wir decken alle Facetten moderner Markt- und Sozialforschung ab. trend·test ist speziell für die telefonische Datenerhebung von Ipsos international tätig. Wir suchen eine:n Berufseinsteiger:in oder Quereinsteiger:in als Project Executive (w/m/d) für trend·test am Standort Berlin. Deine Rolle bei uns In unserem Team arbeitest du gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen für unsere Kunden und bist eigenständig verantwortlich für folgende Aufgaben: Du steuerst CATI-Projekte im nationalen und internationalen Umfeld – unter Beachtung von Qualität, Zeit und Budget. Du organisierst den laufenden Befragungsbetrieb (Markt- und Sozialforschung, kein Sales). Du bewertest, motivierst und betreust Interviewer:innen. Du führst Rekrutierungsmaßnahmen, Informationsveranstaltungen, Bewerbungsgespräche und ganztätige Grundschulungen mit neuen Interviewer:innen durch. Du kümmerst dich um die Prozesse rund um die Weiterentwicklung und Begleitung neuer Interviewer:innen. Du veranstaltest studienbezogene Einweisungen der Interviewer:innen und erstellst die dazugehörige Dokumentation sowie Schulungsunterlagen. Du kontrollierst die Qualität der erhobenen Befragungsdaten. Du unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung bei organisatorischen Aufgaben. Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung von Qualitätsstandards mit. Du kommunizierst mit internen und externen Kunden – national und international. Was du mitbringst Du möchtest deine ersten Erfahrungen in der Markt-, Media-, Politik- und Sozialforschung sammeln oder vertiefen und hast großes Interesse an diesen Themen. Dabei bist du eine kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit sicherem Auftreten gegenüber internen und externen Kunden. Es fällt dir leicht, dich selbst zu motivieren und im Team zu arbeiten. Folgendes solltest du mitbringen: Du denkst analytisch und bringst Kommunikations- sowie Organisationsstärke mit. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und arbeitest präzise. Du arbeitest äußerst strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich, verlässlich und praxisorientiert. Du bringst die Bereitschaft für Abend- und Wochenendeinsätze mit. Du verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse. Du beherrschst Deutsch auf exzellentem und Englisch auf gutem Niveau. Das bieten wir dir Dich erwartet ein Arbeitsumfeld voller Internationalität und Innovation bei Ipsos. Wir betreuen renommierte Kunden aus fast allen großen Branchen und arbeiten weltweit an spannenden Projekten! Du kannst dich freuen auf: Hybrides Arbeiten Flexible Arbeitszeiten Workation im europäischen Ausland Ipsos Corporate Benefits Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket Job Rotation Weiterentwicklung & Learning Culture Internationale Zusammenarbeit Events & Standort Community Diversity & Inclusion Corporate Social Responsibility Moderner Arbeitsplatz Klingt spannend? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse und optional ein kurzes Anschreiben) unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

item.title: Forecaster, Healthcare
item.description: What makes this role important at Ipsos? The Forecaster – Healthcare Market Research position is a specialized role that blends healthcare medical device and technology expertise with forecasting analytics to support healthcare decision-making. The role leverages statistical modeling, market intelligence, and healthcare industry knowledge to predict trends, assess market potential, and guide strategic initiatives. Core Responsibilities Market Research & Analysis: Oversee primary and secondary research to understand HCP and patient needs and preferences, competitor activities, and healthcare market dynamics Forecasting & Modeling: Design, develop and maintain statistical and econometric models to project market growth, product adoption, and sales potential in healthcare sectors Data Analysis: Identify, Source and analyze historical and current healthcare market data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities Collaboration: Work closely with insights, data analytics, marketing, sales, product development, and healthcare operations teams to align forecasts with business strategy Reporting: Prepare detailed reports, dashboards, and presentations for executives and stakeholders, highlighting forecast accuracy and implications Competitive Intelligence: Monitor industry trends, regulatory changes, and competitive landscape to inform market entry, expansion, or product positioning Model Validation: Test forecast accuracy, refining models, and ensure they remain relevant to evolving market conditions Key Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field; advanced degrees preferred Strong analytical and quantitative skills with proficiency in statistical software (e.g., R, Python, SPSS, SAS) and data analysis tools Experience in market research methodologies (primary/secondary, surveys, focus groups, competitive analysis) Understanding of healthcare market structures, reimbursement models, and regulatory environments specific to medical devices, diagnostics and technologies. Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to non-technical audiences. Detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Work Environment The role is dynamic, requiring both analytical rigor and strategic thinking to support healthcare growth and innovation. Why This Role Matters By combining market research depth with forecasting precision, the Forecaster – Healthcare MedTech role helps organizations anticipate market shifts, optimize resource allocation, and make data-driven decisions that drive healthcare product and service success. If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage all who feel they might be a fit for the opportunity to apply. We may consider a variety of backgrounds for a particular role and are also committed to considering candidates for available positions throughout our organization, not just the one you’re applying to! In accordance with NY/CO/CA/WA law, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $180,000. Your final base salary will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors which may include but are not limited to location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education and/or certifications. What’s in it for you: At Ipsos you’ll experience opportunities for Career Development, an exceptional benefits package (including generous PTO, healthcare plans, wellness benefits), a flexible workplace policy, and a strong collaborative culture. To find out more about all the great reasons to work at Ipsos, how we’re making an impact around the world, and more about our benefits and employee programs, please visit: Why Work at Ipsos | US Inclusive Workplace Commitment Ipsos recognizes the necessity of building an inclusive culture that values each employee’s individuality and diverse perspectives. item.description: About Innovation GMU: The Global Modeling Unit (GMU) team within the Innovation service line are methodological “experts” that provide a variety of value-added services. In most cases, value-added services are advanced multivariate data analyses such as regression, GLM, discriminant analysis, MDS, clustering algorithms, and proprietary procedures. What makes this role important at Ipsos? We are looking for someone who is passionate about market research and motivated by a fast-paced and challenging work environment. This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for someone who is interested in starting a career in market research. The Research Analyst, Marketing Science is a resource for internal and external clients in the design and analysis of data based on statistical procedures. As a Research Analyst, you will provide expertise in the appropriate use of value-added analytical models, including approaches proprietary to Ipsos. What you can expect to be doing: Clean, structure, code, and summarize survey and secondary data Use statistical software (SPSS, R, etc.) and business software (Excel) to uncover and evaluate solutions, and assist project staff in running statistical analyses Apply programming skills (Excel VBA, Python, etc.) to help automate standard statistical procedures and chart creation. Demonstrate your understanding of multivariate analysis and Ipsos proprietary products, and work with Client Service from understanding business questions to design, analysis, and application Work from an analytic plan, assemble Excel outputs or PowerPoint decks to provide results and explanations for Client Service Consistently ensure the timely delivery of error free work This might be the job for you if you have: BS degree or MS degree in Quantitative Marketing or Social Sciences, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Research, or a related field of study with an analytic/quantitative/research focus Statistical analysis background is desirable Knowledge and hands-on experience of SPSS or other statistical analysis packages Python, R, VBA coding experience a bonus Understanding of text analytics and AI in marketing research a plus Effective communication skills and ability to present data findings in an easy-to-understand manner to internal and external clients less familiar with statistical techniques Inquisitive personality with a strong desire to learn Ability to work both independently and as part of a team Good attention to details and logical decision-making process If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage all who feel they might be a fit for the opportunity to apply. item.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
item.description: Who We Are: Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. About Customer Experience (CX): Our Customer Experience service line specializes in all matters relating to measuring, managing and improving customer relationships and the overall customer experience. We help our clients manage the experiences they deliver in a way that maximizes the value of both customers and employees to their organization. The Senior Programmer Analyst is a key technical role within CX, sitting at the intersection of research consulting and technical operations. Working alongside a Technical Manager and Director, you'll help deliver end-to-end CX programs for some of our largest clients, building and maintaining the Qualtrics and Medallia platforms at the core of those programs. These are large-scale, high-impact engagements ranging from hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars, giving you meaningful exposure to major clients early in your career. What makes this role important at Ipsos? • The Senior Programmer Analyst turns program requirements into working technology. You'll configure the surveys, dashboards, data feeds, and automations our clients rely on every day, and keep those systems running smoothly. • You'll be an integral part of maintaining and growing long-term client relationships through high-quality execution, clear communication, and responsiveness. What you can expect to be doing: • Programming and maintaining online surveys and building dashboards and reporting within Qualtrics • Writing and running SQL queries to support data processing, reporting, and program needs • Setting up and managing API connections, data integrations, and automations • Processing and loading client-supplied sample files with accuracy and attention to detail • Reviewing specification documents, asking questions to make sure complex requirements are fully understood, and suggesting improvements for clarity and quality • Executing against defined project plans, including more complex tasks, and meeting planned deadlines • Testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving issues within existing programs and system functions; escalating larger issues promptly and submitting support tickets as needed • Taking ownership of ongoing platform maintenance tasks • Supporting report development for QBRs and ad hoc analysis, pulling and preparing data with high quality • Participating in client emails and calls, and potentially leading work streams in client meetings • Explaining technical concepts clearly to non-technical clients and internal stakeholders • Tracking hours carefully, understanding the scope of effort for tasks, and flagging issues proactively This might be the job for you if you have: • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field • 1–3 years of related experience in survey programming, platform configuration, IT, or a technical role within market research or CX • Hands-on technical proficiency with Qualtrics, including survey programming and dashboard configuration, beyond research or reporting use • A background in IT or programming, with comfort using technical language and working across systems • Working knowledge of SQL, plus experience with or a strong interest in APIs, integrations, and automations • Experience with Medallia is a plus • Qualtrics and/or Medallia Product Certification (Level 1) is a plus, or the willingness to earn it • A strong problem-solving mindset and the ability to recognize issues, propose solutions, and work with a technical lead to resolve them • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information to non-technical audiences • Meticulous attention to detail and strong time management, both independently and as part of a team • A willingness to learn and apply new technologies and platform functionality If you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage all who feel they might be a fit for the opportunity to apply. item.description: Senior UX and Human Factors Researcher Who We Are: Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. And we’re proud to share we’ve received our Great Place to Work Certification for 2023! About User Experience and Human Factors (UX & HF): At Ipsos, UX & HF covers all aspects of the end-user’s interaction with a company and its products. UX & HF research is at the heart of user-centered design, grounded in the belief that design decisions should be informed by evidence, research about users, their expectations, their activities, and their interactions. We believe the most impactful experiences come from integrating research throughout the design process, not just evaluating finished concepts. Our UX & HF researchers work across industries, from healthcare and medical devices to digital products and complex systems, to ensure products are safe, effective, and meet real user needs. What makes this role important at Ipsos? The Senior UX & Human Factors Researcher plays a critical role in leading research studies that inform product design, usability, and safety, particularly within regulated industries such as medical devices and pharmaceuticals. This position requires FDA regulatory expertise, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to translate research findings into actionable design recommendations. Senior UX & HF Researchers at Ipsos work collaboratively with cross-functional teams while managing projects independently, from study design to client delivery, ensuring that every engagement meets the highest standards of quality and compliance. What you can expect to be doing: Lead UX and human factors research projects across all study phases (planning, execution, analysis, and reporting). Develop protocols and documentation aligned with industry and regulatory standards (e.g., FDA guidance, ANSI/AAMI HE75, IEC 62366-1:2015). Conduct formative and validation usability testing for medical devices and combination products to identify critical tasks and potential use-related risks. Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to inform risk management, design improvements, and regulatory submissions. Produce clear, high-quality deliverables, such as usability study reports, HF validation summaries, and risk analyses, to support clients’ product development and regulatory objectives. Present insights and recommendations effectively to diverse stakeholders, including client teams, engineers, and regulatory reviewers. Collaborate across internal and client teams to ensure research outcomes drive evidence-based design and business decisions. Engage in client business development work by supporting a Director or senior leader. ​ Lead/support bids and proposals with oversight of a Director or senior leader. ​ Manage set budget with senior lead, including time management of their project team members and budget accountability with their project manager or senior leader. ​ Produce thought leadership pieces, internal trainings and support Senior Leadership in executing internal initiatives. ​ This might be the job for you if you have: Bachelor’s degree in Human Factors, HCI, Psychology, Industrial Engineering, Behavioral Sciences, or a related field ( Bachelor’s degree required ). 3+ years of experience conducting UX and Human Factors research or design within regulated industries. 5+ years of experience in User Experience research or design is highly preferred. Agency/consulting experience preferred. ​ Strong understanding of human factors principles, user research methodologies, and usability evaluation techniques. Practical experience applying regulatory standards (FDA guidance, ANSI/AAMI HE75, IEC 62366-1:2015). Experience executing complex research programs for medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or other safety-critical products. Strong communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging senior-level clients with clarity and confidence. Ability to manage multiple projects autonomously, balancing quality, timelines, and client needs. Proven ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced consulting environment. Open to all locations but living in or near Chicago is preferred , to collaborate with teams at our state-of-the-art Ipsos User Experience Lab.
